name: Customer Groups for Woocommerce
author: wumento

sections.description:
Customer Groups for WooCommerce is a powerful WooCommerce plugin that lets store owners create customer groups, apply customer group pricing, tier pricing, tiered pricing, wholesale pricing, group discounts, product visibility rules, coupon restrictions, and call for price functionality.

Create unlimited customer groups, assign users to groups, apply group discounts, manage product visibility, restrict coupons, and offer custom pricing based on customer groups or purchase quantity.

Whether you run a wholesale store, distributor portal, membership shop, or customer-specific catalog, Customer Groups for WooCommerce gives you complete control over pricing and product access.

Perfect For

👉 Wholesale WooCommerce stores.
👉 WooCommerce B2B Pricing and customer-specific pricing.
👉 WooCommerce Tiered pricing and quantity based discounts.
👉 Customer group discounts.
👉 User group pricing.
👉 WooCommerce Call for price products.
👉 Membership-based stores.
👉 WooCommerce Distributor and reseller pricing.

Key Features

✅ Advanced customer management with customer group column in customer listing.

✅ Create, edit, and manage customer groups directly from the WooCommerce admin panel.

✅ Assign customers to one or multiple customer groups.

✅ Customer group based product visibility and catalog restrictions.

✅ Hide or display products by customer group.

✅ Hide or display products within specific categories for selected customer groups.

✅ Customer group discounts and group pricing rules.

✅ WooCommerce customer pricing for B2B and wholesale stores.

✅ Flexible user group management for personalized shopping experiences.

Premium Features

✅ Unlimited customer groups.

✅ Coupon restrictions based on customer group.

✅ Tier Pricing and Tiered Pricing for WooCommerce products.

Create multiple pricing levels for a single product based on quantity purchased. Perfect for wholesale pricing, bulk discounts, and quantity-based pricing strategies.

✅ Customer Group Pricing.

Set different prices for different customer groups and user groups.

✅ Group Discounts.

Apply percentage or fixed discounts to specific customer groups.

✅ Call for Price Button.

Replace product prices with a Call for Price button for selected customer groups.

✅ Call for Price Popup.

Display a custom message or inquiry form when users click the Call for Price button.

✅ Product Visibility Rules.

Control which products and categories are visible to specific customer groups.

✅ Priority Support for Premium Users.

Use Cases

👉 Wholesale pricing for distributors and resellers.
👉 Customer-specific pricing for B2B customers.
👉 Tiered pricing based on quantity purchased.
👉 Hide products from retail customers.
👉 Show exclusive products to selected customer groups.
👉 Restrict coupons to specific customer groups.
👉 Enable call for price for wholesale or custom-quote products.
👉 Create member-only pricing and private catalogs.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

AUTOMATIC INSTALLATION (EASIEST WAY)

To do an automatic install of ‘Customer Groups for WooCommerce’, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.
In the search field type ‘Customer Groups for WooCommerce’.

Once you have found it you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now” and then “Activate”.

MANUAL INSTALLATION

Installing through WordPress Dashboard

  • Download customer-groups-for-woocommerce.zip
  • Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  • Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  • Select customer-groups-for-woocommerce.zip from your computer
  • Click ‘Install Now’
  • Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

Using FTP

  • Download customer-groups-for-woocommerce.zip
  • Extract the customer-groups-for-woocommerce.zip to your computer
  • Upload the full-screen-background directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard
